name: research_refusal_20261107
comment: ANCHOR: RESEARCH_REFUSAL_20261107 — a refusal is not research (LQ-20261107-316). lib/research_refusal.classify_refusal is the one classifier, anchored at the opening sentence; hermes_external_researcher.classify_reply_status stores a declining reply as status='refused' (COMPLETED/REFUSED_BY_PROFILE, not a lane error); hermes_external_feedback_loop never rates a refused row, reclassifies the rows written before the fix, and states them on the receipt as excluded_reasons — never as produced or skipped.
